test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following States / Union Territories has the highest literacy rate according to Census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshadweep.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• According to Census 2011, Lakshadweep, with a literacy rate of 92.28%, is the Union Territory with the highest literacy rate in India. 

 
• The female literacy rate of Lakshadweep is 88.25%.
 
• Kerala ranks the highest in terms of literacy rate with a 94.00% literacy rate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• As per the 2011 census, the literacy rate of India is 74.04 %.

 
 
• Male literacy rate = 82.14%.
 
• Female literacy rate = 65.46%.
 
 
 
• The top five states and UTs where the literacy rate is the highest, are Kerala (94%), Lakshadweep (91.8%), Mizoram (91.3%), Goa (88.7%), and Tripura (87.2%).
 
• Among the State/UTs, the male and female literacy rate is highest in Kerala (male: 96.11%, female 92.07%) and lowest in Bihar (male: 71.2%, female: 51.5%).
